headline: THE SLAPS GET NAMED
lede: The CLAP TEST graded itself in totals — all three failed phone takes looked identical. The graded screen now speaks one row per slap, in time order: PAIR ✓ ±ms, OFF, NO TOUCH, NO SOUND — so the next take fixes the habit instead of guessing.

notes.text: Report card shipped (#2659, live in index-A3CXdv-a.js): rows built purely from the grader's own residue — matchClapEdges gained timed unmatched lists, verdict bytes byte-identical; recordcheck 257/257, hand-mutant killed 3 named pins.
#1711 audited and released to next: lines 1/2/4 hold (14/14 replay-verified), line 3 waits one completed phone take with ≥3 paired slaps — the card exists so that take is one attempt away.
The rule-5 merge loop started before CI registered its checks: gh pr checks on an empty array errors and the loop exits 1, wearing a merge failure's face. Wait once for IN_PROGRESS, re-run verbatim.

A starved box (three lanes, 12–22 fps) still proved the card: a slow-clock take landed NO TOUCH ×3 + NO SOUND and the card named it truthfully — agreement gates between surfaces don't need clean ms to be worth pinning.
